description: Fork of exp649 (single final residual_lut, E=192 = 1.4948 @ 61.34M). Single change: E 192 -> 384. Keeps the single-final-residual_lut architecture. Side effects: tok_emb_E doubles (+6.29M); out_proj n_outputs doubles (+18.87M total). final_residual_lut input_dim doubles (no weight change since NAP unchanged). Expected total params ~86.50M. Tests whether scaling E up further compensates for the loss from removing per-layer residual_lut accumulation. Reference: exp649 = 1.4948 (single-residual, E=192), exp648 = 1.4827 (6x per-layer, E=192), vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882.
